lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, with highest-intensity clusters concentrated in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like nodal pattern most visible in the center of the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank; the uppermost ridge exhibits a sharp pixel gradient with light illumination on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible on the dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more dispersed blobs on the main body.
